name: VTK Transfer Function Data Conversion & Storage
aliases: VTK TF to GPU Texture Conversion
definition: Converts VTK color and opacity functions into a contiguous 4096x4 RGBA buffer with premultiplied alpha for GPU texture upload.
summary: VTK Transfer Function Data Conversion & Storage converts VTK color and opacity mappings into a fixed 4096-entry premultiplied alpha GPU texture buffer for volume rendering.
